The '''Cambylictus''' was a giant species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the Forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and could also be found in the [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Its roots could only grow in [[Water/Legends|water]], and therefore all Cambylictus grew in lakes and oceans. The roots of the tree had healing properties, and were used by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] as medicine. The Cambylictus trees proved useful in the Gungan's colonization of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]], as their bark provided major resources for the construction of Gungan shelters.

The trees produced [[Cambylictus berry|Camby berries]], which were given by Ewoks as gifts, during their [[Festival of Love]]. They would frequently be dipped in [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]] to be served as chocolate covered Camby berries.
